name: PS5 MicroPython
description: Native PS5 homebrew Python runner and on-console script editor by YAHBALLON, powered by embedded MicroPython v1.26.1. Browse, create, edit, save and execute .py scripts with a DualSense controller, built-in on-screen keyboard and console output. Reads scripts from /data/PS5MicroPython/scripts/ and USB folders, supports bundled examples, persistent user files and runtime/scan logs.
author: YAHBALLON
